textbookText: 6. The frequency of alternating current in our country is 50 Hz. What does it mean?
Ans:- The frequency of alternating current being 50 Hz means the current completes 50 cycles per second.
7. What is magnetic field?
Ans:- A magnetic field is the region around a magnet or a current-carrying conductor where magnetic force can be
experienced.
8. Define magnetic flux.
Ans:- Magnetic flux is the total number of magnetic field lines passing through a given surface.
9. The core of transformer is laminated. Why?
Ans:- The core of a transformer is laminated to reduce energy loss due to eddy currents.
10. What is the magnetic effect of current?
Ans:- The magnetic effect of current is the phenomenon in which an electric current flowing through a
conductor produces a magnetic field around it.
11. What is the effects are demonstrated in the given figures?
Ans:- The given figure demonstrates the magnetic effect of electric current (motor effect), in which a
current-carrying conductor placed in a magnetic field experiences a force.
12. What is electromagnetic induction?
Ans:- Electromagnetic induction is the phenomenon in which an electric current or emf is induced in a conductor when there
is a change in magnetic flux linked with it.
Section 'C'
Short answer type questions.
1. Which type of transformer is given in the figure? Which substance is used to laminate its core? The number of turns of
primary coil and the number of turns of secondary coil in a transformer are never made equal,
why?
Ans:- The given figure shows a step-down transformer, because the primary winding has more
turns than the secondary winding. The core is laminated with thin sheets of soft iron (silicon steel)
to reduce eddy current losses. The number of turns of the primary and secondary coils are not
made equal because a transformer is meant to change the voltage level, and if both had equal
turns, the induced voltages would be equal and no transformation would occur.
2. Write the differences between electric motor and dynamo.
Ans:- The differences between electric motor and dynamo are,
Electric Motor
Dynamo
It converts electrical energy into mechanical energy.
It converts mechanical energy into electrical energy.
It works on the principle of electromagnetic effect.
It works on the principle of electromagnetic induction.
3. Write two uses of transformer.
Ans:- Two uses of transformer are,
1. A transformer is used to step up or step down voltage in power transmission and distribution systems.
2. A transformer is used in electrical appliances and electronic devices (such as chargers and adapters) to supply the
required voltage safely.
